summary: Iteration 8 — Final /ai-factory product-design pass verification (both backend + frontend). Backend pytest 7/7 pass. Frontend: /ai-factory renders hero + kicker 'WHAT IS AI FACTORY?' + tagline + chain 'INDUSTRY → PROBLEM → SOLUTION → DEPLOYMENT' + IndustrySelector (4 tabs) + FactoryFloor with exactly 3 stations (understand/decide/deploy — floor-layer-act count=0) + SolutionRack (3 bays). All 12 solutions verified via deep-link across the 4 industries with correct data-testid ids and correct label chips (Healthcare: claimkavach+vaidya-ai CALYZA, clinical-document-prior-auth-copilot BLUEPRINT; FinTech: policy-copilot+rbi-regtech CALYZA, kyc-lending-intelligence BLUEPRINT; Education: all 3 BLUEPRINT; Hospitality: all 3 BLUEPRINT). In-page tab switching also works (bays swap correctly). rbi-regtech decide block contains 'Deterministic compliance rules' + 'Backtesting'; deploy contains 'Point-in-time replay' — spec-accurate. Safety notes verified via [data-testid=solution-note] textContent: ClaimKavach note ('ClaimKavach does not submit claims on behalf of the hospital.'), Vaidya AI ('...does not diagnose, prescribe or replace doctors'), RBI RegTech ('The rule decides. The model drafts and explains.') all present; blueprint outcomes = 'Designed for deployment. Ready to be validated in a pilot.' No fabricated proof: full-page text scan across all 4 industries → 0 percentages, 0 dollar amounts, 0 ROI mentions. Solution mode mechanics: deep-link ?industry=fintech&solution=rbi-regtech opens SolutionMode directly; scrolling the 3 solution-block-{understand,decide,deploy} charges deployment-readiness signals in order; at 3/3 system-ready appears with factory-cta-build (href=/contact) + factory-cta-explore, floor-status becomes 'SYS — READY', floor-ready-bloom overlay renders. 'Explore another solution' clears ?solution and closes solution-mode. Canvas count = exactly 1 on floor and 1 in solution mode. Zero console errors and zero pageerrors on all tested flows. Deep-link ?industry=bogus&solution=bogus falls back to healthcare and shows no solution mode (graceful). Refresh with deep link + back/forward navigation across solution open/closed states all work. Mobile 390px docWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow). Homepage regression: factory-invitation + enter-factory-cta present with canvas=1. Backend pytest still 7/7.
critical_code_review_comments: SolutionRack uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' with 0.35s exit — total swap ~700ms. Any automated test polling too soon after industry click will see 0 bays (already accounted for; not a user-facing bug).
Solution notes rely on CSS `uppercase` text-transform. Automation should use element.textContent (case-insensitive) rather than inner_text() when validating note strings.
FactoryFloor IntersectionObserver correctly parks stageInView when offscreen; single canvas invariant preserved (exactly 1 canvas on both floor + solution mode) — meets performance spec.
Deep-link solution mode auto-scroll uses a setTimeout(90ms) — works reliably in tests; consider scrollIntoView with 'smooth' on next enhancement.

All required data-testids present and stable: ai-factory-page, factory-chain, industry-selector, industry-select-*, factory-floor, floor-layer-{understand,decide,deploy}, floor-crystal, floor-status, floor-ready-bloom, solution-rack, solution-bay-*, solution-open-*, solution-mode, solution-mode-label, solution-block-*, workflow-step-*, deployment-readiness, readiness-*, readiness-complete, system-ready, factory-cta-build, factory-cta-explore, solution-outcome, solution-note, label-calyza-solution, label-blueprint.
